script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', k.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', k.progress_message, 'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message, 'action', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload,
		'$.action')), NULL), 'lot_no', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.lotNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.key}}' AND k.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'no', h.stock_movement_no) AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer h
         WHERE '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.draftAdd}}' = 'YES' AND h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.lot_idem_key,
		'#', 1) = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.key}}' AND h.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY h.id LIMIT 1) AS key_lot,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS lot_id, g.stock_movement_no, g.stock_movement_status, g.organization_id,
       CAST(g.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(g.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR) AS no_type, g.movement_type,
       DATE_FORMAT(g.issue_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS issue_date, g.is_production_order,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l
         WHERE {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}} > 0 AND l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND NOT (COALESCE(l.item_bundle_id, '') <> '' AND l.parent_id IS NULL)) AS line_count,
       (SELECT p.step_name FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'SMLT|{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', o.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', o.progress_message, 'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message, 'action', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload,
		'$.action')), NULL), 'lot_no', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.lotNo')), NULL))) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}} > 0 AND o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command = 'SAVE_LOT' AND o.correlation_id = 'LOT|{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}}' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED',
		'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_LOT', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', x.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', x.progress_message, 'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message, 'action', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload,
		'$.action')), NULL), 'lot_no', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.lotNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}} > 0 AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'SAVE_LOT' AND x.correlation_id = 'LOT|{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}}' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job,
       CAST(g.lot_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS lot_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(y.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', y.job_status, 'correlation_id', y.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', y.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', y.progress_message, 'error_code', y.error_code, 'error_message', y.error_message, 'action', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload,
		'$.action')), NULL), 'lot_no', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.lotNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job y
         WHERE y.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND y.is_deleted = 0 AND y.command = 'SAVE_LOT' AND y.id = CAST(g.lot_v2_job_id AS UNSIGNED)) AS link_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job r
         WHERE {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}} > 0 AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.command = 'SAVE_LOT' AND r.correlation_id = 'LOT|{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}}' AND JSON_VALID(r.request_payload)
           AND COALESCE(g.stock_movement_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.request_payload, '$.issuedNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.stock_movement_no) AS issued_reuse
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_location_transfer g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_LSguard.data.lotId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('t', x.t, 'm', CAST(x.m AS CHAR), 'b', CAST(x.b AS CHAR), 'n', x.n) AS j
  FROM (SELECT 'W' AS t, w.material_id AS m, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM wa_costing_method w
         WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.plantId}}' AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND (w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}}) OR w.material_id IN (SELECT CAST(s.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub s WHERE {{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.storedLotId}} > 0 AND s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.storedLotId}} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.item_selection REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$'))
         GROUP BY w.material_id, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'F' AS t, f.material_id AS m, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM fifo_costing_history f
         WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.plant_id = {{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.plantId}} AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND (f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}}) OR f.material_id IN (SELECT CAST(s.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub s WHERE {{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.storedLotId}} > 0 AND s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.sm_location_transfer_id = {{node:code_node_LSkeys.data.storedLotId}} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.item_selection REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$'))
         GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0)) x

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id, j.job_status, j.correlation_id,
       g.stock_movement_status, g.stock_movement_no, CAST(g.lot_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS lot_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('SMLT|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 5)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step q
         WHERE q.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND q.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND q.step_name LIKE 'S|%' AND q.is_deleted = 0) AS parts
  FROM gd_async_job j
  LEFT JOIN sm_location_transfer g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 5) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_LSguard.data.key}}' AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
